newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S DESC SAYS BUYS CORFUERTE.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S DESC SAYS BUYS CORFUERTE.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate Desc Sociedad de Fomento Industrial (Desc) said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle to take over food processor Corfuerte S.A.
Desc said in a statement that it had arrived at the agreemnt with shareholders and creditor banks of Corfuerte.
Corfuerte had sales of $84.6 million in 1996 from its network of production plants and distribution centers in Mexico and the United States.
Desc sells autoparts, chemicals, food, consumer products and is involved in real estate.
It said it estimates that its food sales can increase to about $340 million in 1998 with the acquisition.
It gave no sales price for the deal.
